name: Goa
description: India's beach paradise famous for palm-fringed coastlines, Portuguese heritage, buzzing nightlife, and serene backwaters.

name: Kerala
description: God's Own Country, famed for tranquil houseboats, tea gardens in Munnar, Ayurvedic wellness, and lush backwaters.

name: Rajasthan
description: The Land of Kings adorned with regal forts, golden deserts, opulent palaces, and vibrant cultural folk traditions.

name: Jammu & Kashmir
description: Paradise on Earth with snowy Himalayan peaks, Dal Lake shikaras, tulip gardens, and pristine alpine meadows.

name: Ladakh
description: High-altitude desert wonderland featuring turquoise Pangong Lake, ancient Buddhist monasteries, and dramatic mountain passes.

name: Himachal Pradesh
description: Land of Gods nestled in the Himalayas, offering pine forests, adventure sports, river rafting, and scenic hill stations.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June & Dec to Feb

name: Uttarakhand
description: Devbhoomi sacred land of yoga, holy rivers, national parks, Himalayan peaks, and serene spiritual retreats.
bestTimeToVisit: March to June & Sept to Nov

name: Andaman & Nicobar
description: Tropical paradise of crystal clear blue waters, coral reefs, white sand beaches, and historic celluar heritage.
